description: This file defines several interfaces related to grain subscription counters in an Orleans-based project. It includes core interfaces for implicit subscription counting, as well as specialized interfaces for fast and slow variants.

methods.name: GetEventCounter
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the event counter.

methods.name: GetErrorCounter
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the error counter.

methods.name: DeactivateOnEvent
methods.description: Method to deactivate the grain based on an event, with a boolean parameter specifying the condition.
